name: Cassius
source:
"It's cute you want to know me, but you should be careful who you let close. I'm a demon after all, there's a reason people fear us."

Cassius, known as the Gilded Blade, seems no stranger to violence and dirty deeds. Still, this arrogant demon appears to have a scholarly side to him, as his visits to Yonder World are often spent alone in the laboratory.

A sense of danger and intrigue lay behind Cassius' devilish smirk.

[From [url=https://flutteringabyss.itch.io/yonderworld]Itch.io[/url]]
